why: The terminal holder's refusals (wave 13u). No door here can meet them without a terminal holder running, so a test route throws each in the doors' own shape. Closing an agent's terminal under the grant is tested through its real door in the terminal grant test; this test app has no holder with an agent's run.

refusals.english: Test: the terminal holder did not answer.
Test: the terminal holder cannot be used.
Test: the holder holds no such terminal.
Test: there is no line to keep.
Test: the line changed since it was read.
Test: the terminal holder did not start.
Test: the terminal holder is turned off.
Under the person's grant, a secretary may close only a terminal no agent runs in. Nothing was closed.
